headword: {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}
gloss: door-to-door sales; sales visits without an appointment

definitions.gloss: door-to-door sales; sales visits without an appointment
definitions.explanation: the practice of visiting potential customers or businesses without prior appointment to sell products or services

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To make sales visits without an appointment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: New employees start out by knocking on doors.

examples.japanese: {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{断|ことわ}られる→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Salespeople who show up without an appointment get turned away a lot.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {訪問販売|ほうもんはんばい}: door-to-door selling, usually to households; also the legal term
- テレアポ: phoning to set up appointments — the telephone counterpart, closer to English "cold calling"
- ルート⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧: regular visits to existing customers — the opposite of {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}をする: to canvass without appointments
- {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to go round making unannounced sales visits
- {門前払|もんぜんばら}いされる: to be turned away at the door

cross_references.label: to jump into, to dive into, to rush into
